domain_hint: Conjugate heat transfer of a finned heat sink in an aircraft environmental control duct cooling an avionics module
ambiguity_notes:
- Physics toggles conflict: radiation stated off/negligible on one slide but later trial shows 1.5–2.3 C impact and some runs had it enabled
- Input inconsistency: modeled mass flow 0.48 kg/s vs tests at 0.60 kg/s; dry air assumption vs reported 50% RH in installed test
- Mesh independence vs convergence: claim of <0.4 C grid effect conflicts with late-iteration 0.5 C drift and 2.1 C change when switching coupling
- Code checks: 1–2% heat transfer benchmark error vs a 6% deviation on a conjugate case before rerun/patch
- Contact interface: baseline 8,000 W/m2-K vs 12,000 W/m2-K used for closer fit in calibration note
- Operational limit inconsistency: allowable 80 C cited early but recommendation later caps at 75 C
- Process control: repository discipline asserted but presence of “final_final3.cas.h5” outside version control and unlogged radiation toggles
